## ✅ Space Invaders Project Complete — 24 Files Written

### File Inventory by Category

**Shared Utilities (7 files)** — reusable across all games:

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `shared/core/GameEngine.js` | Game loop, state machine (`menu → playing → paused → gameOver`) |
| `shared/core/InputHandler.js` | Unified keyboard + gamepad input abstraction |
| `shared/utils/Pool.js` | Object pooling for projectiles, entities, particles (prevents GC pressure) |
| `shared/vfs/CameraShake.js` | Trauma-based camera shake with exponential decay |
| `shared/vfs/HitStop.js` | Frame-dilation hit-stop system (8-frame timescale dilation on impact) |
| `shared/vfs/MotionTrail.js` | Trail buffer for fast-moving objects (capped at 15 snapshots) |
| `shared/vfs/Shockwave.js` | Expanding shockwave rings on all impacts/deaths |

| File | Purpose |

| `src/plan.md` | Comprehensive design document (18 modern enhancements, full architecture) |

### Key Features Implemented

- **PBR Materials** — All entities use `MeshStandardMaterial` with emissive glow tuned per enemy type (squid: cyan, crab: magenta, octopus: yellow-green)
- **Post-Processing Stack** — EffectComposer → UnrealBloomPass (threshold 0.3, radius 2.0, strength 1.5) → ToneCurvePass → VignettePass
- **Hard Particle Cap** — `ParticleSystem` enforces a strict limit of 500 active particles with LRU eviction
- **Object Pooling** — All projectiles and enemies are pooled; nothing is created/destroyed during gameplay
- **Hit-Stop** — 8-frame (133ms) timescale dilation on player death, scaling by impact severity
- **Camera Shake** — Trauma-based system with intensity proportional to enemy destruction size
